intro: Second Peter was written near the end of Peter's life, as a reminder: grow in your faith, and beware of false teachers.
Chapter one urges growth in goodness and knowledge. Chapter two warns against false teachers. Chapter three answers those who mock the Lord's return: with the Lord, one day is as a thousand years.
Listen for the last line: grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
